notes.title: Patch Notes 0.218
notes.notes:
Patch Notes

08/28/2022
Improvements/Changes

- Replaced UI elements

- New prioritization system for gathering/attacking. Now only unable to gather if an enemy is currently pursuing you.

- Added Interact option to progress through quest dialogue sequences.

- Added materials inventory to crafting menus.

- Added tooltips/Level unlock requirements to affinity skills.

- Added Stat Information to Character Screen, as well as new level xp bar and level widget on main HUD.

- Increase lighting in ruins/caves.

- Removed non gatherable thyme from river area. 

- Add crafting stations to villages and portal entrances or at the very beginning inside portals have a camp site they can prepare at.

- Adjusted Affinity XP ratios.

- Rebalanced attribute points and what stats they affect.

- Changed lightning dance functionality to now reduce damage output depending on how many enemies you are chaining (Max 5.)

- Fix loot not dropping properly in dungeon 1.

- Fixed Mandela lightning strike spawning after death.

- Removed Tremble from Land Affinity Stance.

- Re Balance the white tree quest and fix spawning bug.

- Lowered the Azure witchs health.

- Place proper crafting tables at dyanis village

- Fix iron ore quest requirement progress.

- Fixed nameplate and tree location for Vrytenbog trees.

- Fixed master crowe not appearing in path of rememberence quest.

- Fixed Enemies not damaging the player properly.

- Fix Catharsis quest by initializing area progress.

- Overall balance to enemy and player stats in order to encourage crafting. (WIP)
